semantic_differences.identity_relation: Tensor methods are wrappers calling the exported dispatch target; they are not asserted to be identical function objects. __radd__ is a distinct coercion/control-flow path.
shape_dtype_values: Elementwise addition; preserve broadcasting, numeric/complex dtype rules, and string concatenation as distinct domains.
Without auto dtype conversion, non-Tensor/non-SparseTensor RHS converts with the LHS base dtype as hint. String uses raw Add; other dtypes use AddV2.
When auto dtype conversion is enabled, the target calls add instead. NumPy style promotion is a separate flag/path in maybe_promote_tensors; its name does not prove NumPy equivalence.

Forward wrapper uses force_same_dtype=False; reflected wrapper uses force_same_dtype=True and reverses operand call order. Custom RHS __radd__ is retried after TypeError/ValueError, with original-error preservation.
gradient: Add/AddV2 register _AddGrad with broadcast-gradient reduction; analytic first/higher-order coverage remains unrun, especially complex and promotion paths. String/non-differentiable dtype behavior must be specified separately.
execution_error: Preserve eager, traced function, legacy graph and jit-compiled behavior independently; wrapper conversion, custom dispatch, RHS error preservation and kernel errors are separate outcomes.
layout_device: No view/aliasing or physical layout equivalence inferred from elementwise math. Device/kernel/transfer coverage remains unqualified; no CPU fallback counts as device parity.

semantic_differences.identity_relation: Tensor._override_operator delegates to setattr(Tensor, __getitem__, dispatched _slice_helper). This direct source binding is distinct from a numeric or whole-workflow equivalence assertion.
shape_dtype_values: Basic scalar integer/slice/ellipsis/newaxis semantics map to StridedSlice masks and shrink axes; negative strides and boolean-mask special branch are retained.
With var=None and ops._numpy_style_slicing enabled, calls tensor._numpy_style_getitem; default basic-indexing prose cannot exclude this public mode.

Doc prose names scalar int32/int64; source accepted dtype set also contains int16 and int32_ref/int64_ref. Preserve discrepancy and test actual supported ranks/dtypes rather than inventing equivalence.
Packed indices may be promoted to int64 or int16; empty slice spec uses empty int32 begin/end/strides. Non-scalar advanced indexing behavior depends on the slicing mode.
gradient: StridedSlice and StridedSliceGrad have registered gradient functions. Value gradients scatter into source shape; begin/end/stride inputs return None. Boolean-mask and NumPy style paths require their own reverse/forward/higher-order proof.
execution_error: Invalid index type raises TypeError; kernel bounds/zero stride/rank errors need independent eager/graph/jit expectations.
var parameter and _slice_helper_var preserve mutable resource slicing/assignment workflow; they must not be treated as immutable Tensor view equivalence.
layout_device: Do not infer shared-storage view semantics from slicing notation. Device/index dtype placement, resource aliasing and backend support remain unqualified; fallback/transfer is explicit.

semantic_differences.identity_relation: RaggedTensor.__getitem__ is assigned the dispatched ragged_tensor_getitem function in source. Retain this binding and export identity without merging with dense indexing semantics.
shape_dtype_values: Supports Python/scalar integer Tensor keys, integer slices, ellipsis, newaxis and multidimensional tuples, preserving row partition structure.
Returns Tensor when no ragged dimensions remain and RaggedTensor otherwise; source examples include string values.
An inner ragged-dimension scalar index raises ValueError; an inner uniform dimension has a separate allowed path. Unknown-shape ellipsis is explicitly rejected.
Requires RaggedTensor input; otherwise TypeError. Preserve row_splits dtype, empty rows, negative indexing, uniform-row metadata and dense/ragged return distinction.
gradient: Slicing is composite over value/partition operations; value-gradient analytical scatter, partition nondifferentiability, JVP and higher-order behavior remain unverified. Do not infer gradient completeness from dense StridedSlice registration.
execution_error: Positive out-of-bounds outer row index has explicit eager IndexError check to support Python iteration. Non-eager detection occurs when executing graph operations; exact error/timing remains an independent mode obligation.
The prose advertises ValueError for out-of-bounds but source has the eager IndexError branch; retain discrepancy rather than silently selecting one.
layout_device: Ragged partition layout, nested ragged rank, values/residency, gradients and each backend remain unqualified. Never materialize dense/padded CPU data silently as parity.
